body:
closes #27215

When an object array mixes types, `_hash_ndarray` falls back to `vals.astype(str)`, and numpy decodes `bytes` elements as ASCII, so non-ASCII bytes raised `UnicodeDecodeError` under any `encoding`. The fallback now leaves `bytes` elements as-is and stringifies the rest as before, so a `bytes` value hashes the same in a mixed array as in a non-mixed one.

Hashes of previously-working inputs are unchanged, except `bytes` that `astype(str)` used to alter: trailing NULs (`b"a\x00"` used to collide with `b"a"`) and ASCII bytes under encodings that re-encode ASCII differently (e.g. cp500).

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), which reproduced the bug, wrote the fix and tests, and ran a differential sweep against main.
title: BUG: hash_pandas_object raised on mixed-type values with non-ASCII bytes (GH#27215)
